ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it
questions: What is the total amount of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste and abuse of taxpayer dollars. By analyzing data and conducting interviews with experts, we can shed light on the extent of the problem and identify potential solutions.
